Name: Annual audit on domestic incident reports.
Title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter, in relation to an annual audit on domestic incident reports

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council

Summary: This bill would require the department of investigation to complete an annual audit of and publish a report on the use of domestic incident reports by the New York city police department.

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:\ulnone\par
\pard\ltrpar\fi720\qj\par
\pard\ltrpar\fi720\sl480\slmult1\qj Section 1. Section 803 of chapter 34 of the New York city charter is amended by adding a new subdivision j to read as follows: \par
\ul j. No later than 180 days after the enactment of the local law that added this subdivision, and annually thereafter, the commissioner shall complete an audit of and submit a report to the council on domestic incident reports completed by the New York city police department. Such report shall include, at minimum: \par
1. The total number of domestic incident reports completed, disaggregated by borough, council district, and police precinct; \par
2. The percentage of domestic incident reports submitted with every mandatory field completed;\par
3. The fields most commonly left blank on domestic incident reports, and whether such fields are mandatory; \par
4. The percentage of domestic incident reports indicating that hotline numbers, victim rights notices, or service referrals were provided to victims; \par
5. The percentage of domestic incident reports submitted within 24 hours of the underlying incident; \par
6. The percentage of domestic incident reports indicating the registry for orders of protection was checked; \par
7. The percentage of domestic incident reports indicating an order of protection was in effect, disaggregated by form response, such as yes, no, refrain, or stay away; and \par
8. Recommendations regarding improving the New York police department\rquote s use of domestic incident reports and compliance with state law relating to such reports. \par
\pard\ltrpar\qj\ulnone\'a7 2.  This local law takes effect immediately. \fs18\par
